item.title: 'Ba kama ni aka yi ba': Sheikh Ahmad Umar ya musanta rahoton cafke shi a Kaduna
item.description: Bayan ikirarin cafke Malamin addinin Musulunci daga Kaduna, Malam Ahmad Umar, ya musanta rahoton cewa DSS ta kama shi bayan ziyarar Mr. Peter Obi.

item.title: Pakistan za ta zama dandalin sulhu tsakanin Amurka da Iran
item.description: A labarin nan, za a ji cewa kasar Pakistan ta bayyana aniyarta da zama kafar sulhu da Amurka da Iran za su zauna domin kawo karshen yaki Gabas ta Tsakiya.

item.title: EFCC ta kai samame gidan Abubakar Malami domin kwace kadararsa a Abuja
item.description: Jami'an hukumar EFCC a Abuja ta kai samame gidan tsohon Ministan Shari’a Abubakar Malami a Maitama da ke birnin, domin kwace kadararsa ba tare da takardar kotu ba.

item.title: Asiri ya tonu: An gano yariman Saudiyya yana tunzura Trump a yaki da Iran
item.description: Yarima Mohammed bin Salman ya matsa wa Donald Trump lamba domin ya ci gaba da yaƙi da Iran, inda ya bayyana lamarin a matsayin "dama" ga yankin Gabas ta Tsakiya.

item.title: Hakeem Baba Ahmed ya fadawa Tinubu mawuyacin halin da ya jefa 'yan Najeriya
item.description: Hakeem Baba-Ahmed, tsohon mai ba Tinubu shawara, ya bayyana cewa Najeriya ta tsinci kanta a cikin matsalar tsaro da na tattalin arziki mafi muni a karkashin APC.

item.title: 'Ya taba yin fashi a banki': Baban Chinedu ya fallasa Fasto Dachomo
item.description: Malam Yusuf Haruna Baban Chinedu ya zargi Fasto Ezekiel Dachomo da kasancewa tsohon ɗan fashi, yana cewa ya ƙirƙiri labarin haduwarsa da Yesu bayan harin banki.

item.title: 'Kyauta ce mai girma ƙwarai': Trump ya yaba wa shugabannin Iran kan abin alheri
item.description: Shugaba Donald Trump na Amurka ya ce Iran ta ba Amurka “kyauta mai daraja sosai” da ta shafi mai da gas da mashigar Strait of Hormuz yayin da ake ci gaba da yaki.

item.title: Tinubu ya cimma matsaya da Tarayyar Turai, za a karfafa tsaro a Najeriya
item.description: Tarayyar Turai (EU) da Najeriya sun amince su faɗaɗa haɗin gwiwa kan hakar ma'adanai, tsaro, da kasuwanci yayin da ake fama da yaki a Gabas ta Tsakiya.

item.title: 'Akwai hujjoji':Ukraine ta zargi Rasha da ba Iran bayanan sirri a yakin Isra'ila
item.description: Shugaban Ukraine, Volodymyr Zelenskiy ya ce kasarsa ta samu hujja karara cewa Rasha na bai wa Iran bayanan sirri, lamarin da zai kara tsawaita rikicin.

item.title: Makami mai linzami da Iran ta harba ya sauka Tel Aviv, mutane da dama sun mutu
item.description: Harin makami mai linzami da Iran ta kai Tel Aviv a ranar 24 ga Maris ya kashe aƙalla mutane 16, tare da ruguza gine-gine da jikkata wasu da dama.
